answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in beacon, verified in walnut, and canyon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 25 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
